value.name: locate missing medical directive
value.description: Asha learns that the green folder containing the medical directive should have been in the top drawer of the nightstand but is missing.
evidence: there was a green folder in the top drawer of the nightstand. She kept her medical directive there.
She said if anything happened in the night she did not want the paramedics to have to go looking.

value.name: inspect empty nightstand drawer
value.description: Asha opens the nightstand drawer and finds personal items but no green folder.
evidence: The drawer slid open with the small reluctance of old runners.
Inside: a rosary, a tube of hand cream, a paperback novel in Spanish with a bookmark a third of the way through, a flashlight, two AA batteries loose and rolling, and no folder of any color.

value.name: question last sighting of directive
value.description: Asha asks Rosa when she last saw the medical directive in the drawer.
evidence: "Rosa," she said, "when did you last see the medical directive in this drawer."

value.name: confirm directive was present days earlier
value.description: Rosa says she last saw the medical directive three days before the woman died and had read it to her then.
evidence: "I read it to her. She asked me to. She wanted to make sure it said what she remembered it saying."

value.name: ask about the will
value.description: Asha shifts the questioning to whether the deceased woman said anything about the will.
evidence: "Did she say anything that day about the will."

value.name: relay instruction about green folder
value.description: Rosa reports that the deceased woman instructed her to ensure the green folder in the desk went to the lawyer first.
evidence: "She said, Rosa, when the time comes, make sure the green folder in the desk goes to the lawyer first. Before anyone else opens the desk."

value.name: discover desk already opened
value.description: Rosa says that the morning after the death she found the desk drawer already open and the folder missing.
evidence: "On the morning after she died I went to the desk and the drawer was already open. The folder was not there."

value.name: suspect Lucia took folder
value.description: Rosa initially thinks Lucia may have taken the missing folder.
evidence: "I thought perhaps Lucia had taken it."

value.name: find Lucia at kitchen table
value.description: Rosa goes to the kitchen and sees Lucia sitting at the table with coffee, suggesting she had not taken the folder.
evidence: "I went down to the kitchen and Lucia was at the table with her coffee and she had not"
